inputs.text: A hero product photograph of one standard 330 ml aluminium soda can standing upright in the grass of a sunny green meadow, low camera angle, soft out-of-focus wildflowers in the foreground, bright daylight, a few cold condensation droplets on the can, tall portrait frame. The can has a lime-green wrap-around label that faces the camera. In the upper half of the label, huge bold black sans-serif capitals on two lines: "GRA" on the first line and "WWWW" directly below it, the four W's coloured cyan, magenta, yellow and black. At the bottom of the label, a yellow rectangular band with the word "LIME" in bold black sans-serif capitals. The brand name is spelled G, R, A, then four W (seven letters). No other text.
